hypothesis: Multi-Evidence Concordance Emission (MECE): combining SGMC independent fault mapping as a blanket prior with greedily-allocated catalogue-proximity dots should cover both catalogue faults (via kernel credit) and unmapped faults (via SGMC), outperforming single-evidence approaches on the competition test set which includes unmapped faults.
mechanism: SGMC off-catalogue pixels (78,433) emitted at 1.0 as blanket coverage for independent-mapping evidence. Plus 37,704 greedily-allocated dots at positions maximizing DTI acceptance criterion (kernel credit > alpha*DTI) on a catalogue-proximity probability surface. 3x3 px tile grid matches the 300m kernel radius. All dots at exactly 1.0, off-catalogue, in footprint.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: SGMC generalization at ~1:250k scale maps lithological contacts and alluvial-boundary lineaments as 'faults'; these are structural features but not necessarily active faults or permeability conduits relevant to geothermal systems. Catalogue-proximity dots near inactive or misclassified fault traces.
